params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 preloads are open, with a new trailer to match Rockstar released a fresh trailer announcing that GTA 6 preloads have begun, packing nearly 30 seconds of new footage including a SWAT team and nightclub scenes. The trailer also highlights PS5-exclusive DualSense features such as haptic feedback, ahead of the game's launch next week. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 18:15 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN #GTA6 #Rockstar #GamingNews
